No daily front door

Demand depends on the next post

7 reels in 7 days at around 6.6k views each is real reach, but every new lead still starts with you showing up again. That lever is capped by your time.

No bridge

From a reel straight to a $1,497+ decision

A woman can listen for months and buy the book, then the next step is BECOMING. Nothing in between lets her experience your teaching live and raise her hand when she is ready.

No filter

No way to spot the Fully Guided buyer

Unless something qualifies women first, you can’t tell a curious listener from a woman ready for weekly live coaching with you, so the best-fit buyers get the same path as everyone else.

Thousands of women already trust your voice. Most never get an easy next step, and the few ready for Fully Guided BECOMING can’t be told apart from the rest.

A free live masterclass, “Outgrow Who You Had to Be”, as an always-on front door to The School of Becoming

The class runs every week from ads, as a front door to BECOMING and everything you already have. It offers Worthy Human to women not ready yet, and sends the women who are ready into a short application, a call, and Fully Guided BECOMING.

Fixes the missing front door

A free hour with you is an easy yes for a woman who has listened to the podcast for months, and every seat is an email address you own. Ads keep it full without you posting more.

Fixes the missing bridge

Women who want more but aren’t ready for private work take Worthy Human home the same day, so the relationship deepens and starts to pay for the ads.

Fixes the missing filter

Only women who attend, stay and apply reach a call, already knowing how you work. The pre-call emails prepare them for Fully Guided BECOMING.

The 95%*

Not ready for BECOMING yet

They take the free class, add the Worthy Human bundle on the thank-you page and keep learning with you through the podcast and the Substack until they are. You get paid to start the relationship.

The qualified 5%

Ready to go deeper with you

They show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters them, and the call places them in Fully Guided BECOMING at $3,497.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Who this class is for

The version of you that got you here isn’t the one who takes you further.

  • She has the title, the income and the respect, and still feels like she’s performing a role.
  • She knows exactly what she “should” do, and keeps choosing the old pattern anyway.
  • She has outgrown the rules that made her successful, and isn’t sure what replaces them.
  • She wants to lead her life from choice, not from proving.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

The identity that built your success

Why the woman who got you here was the right person for that chapter, and why she can quietly hold the next one back.

Why knowing better isn’t being different

Why insight alone rarely changes how you show up, and what has to shift at the level of identity.

A first look at The Choice Method®

The framework at the heart of The School of Becoming, introduced in plain language.

A daily practice for becoming

A simple way to choose who you’re becoming each morning, in minutes, not hours.

Script 1 · “Who you had to be”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The woman who got you here is not the woman who takes you further.”

Body

“She was brilliant. She pushed, she proved, she held it all together. And somewhere along the way she became a role you play. Outgrowing her isn’t losing your edge. It’s choosing who you are now.”

CTA

“I’m teaching how in a free 60-minute class, Outgrow Who You Had to Be. Replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, white top, bright light background, warm natural light.

Script 2 · “Knowing better”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You already know what you should do. So why do you keep doing the old thing?”

Body

“Because knowing better isn’t the same as being different. Insight lives in your head. Change happens when you start choosing from a new identity, one small choice at a time.”

CTA

“Join my free live masterclass and I’ll show you where to start. Tap Sign up to save a seat.”

Shot: walking toward camera, cut to on-screen text “knowing better ≠ being different”.
